plan: Drive: from Village of Valemount, about 223 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 5, Blackman Rd, Hwy 16 (McBride Hwy 16 E), Hwy 16 (McBride Hwy 16 W).
Park: 53.97299, -121.00141, pull off on Sande Road FSR (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 230 m N, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 0 m, about 5 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: moose, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-17, Region 7A. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-05, closures 2026-10-16.
R7AC-moose-drive-0001.popWhy: Popular (more hunters): MU 7-17: about 1,422 hunter days a year for moose (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.52 days per square km, top third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.2 km and about 0 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
